{{Top|leg}}
'''Shock-therapy''' was a form of treatment that consisted of passing an electrical stimulus through the [[Brain/Legends|brain]], from one side of the head to the other.

[[Triclops]], the three-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[mutant]] son of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], endured shock-therapy, which scarred his temples and drove him insane.
